hero_subtitle: Celebrating over a century of faith and spiritual legacy in Inagaluru, Kadiri region. Experience divine grace, ancient traditions, and sacred service.
floating_desc: Watch photos and sacred videos float gracefully. Tap or hover over any media card to enlarge photos or play divine videos.
history_desc: From the grand construction in 1923 by Sri Pancharatnam Subbaraamappa Garu to the monumental 2024 grand reconstruction.
timeline_1800_desc: Sri Pancharatnam Subbaraamappa Garu constructed the sacred temple in Inagaluru, Kadiri region, establishing it as a spiritual center.
timeline_1900_desc: The temple evolved into a center for spiritual literature, Ramayana discourses, and traditional Vedic learning.
timeline_2020_desc: Initial blueprints drawn blending ancient Shilpa Shastra stone craftsmanship with enduring structural excellence.
timeline_2024_desc: Inauguration of the majestic granite temple complex built with 100% community devotion and shramadaana.
founder_quote: "Real service is not in the acts of building walls, but in nourishing the soul and feeding the hungry. In the name of Sri Raama, we serve all."
founder_desc: For three decades, Sri Subbaraamappa Gaaru's selfless service sustained the Kadiri Lakshmi Narasimha Swami Anna Daana Satram, ensuring no pilgrim left hungry.
service1_title: Kadiri Lakshmi Narasimha Swami Anna Daana Satram
service1_desc: Providing free sanctified meals (Prasadam) daily to hundreds of devotees and visiting pilgrims.
service2_desc: Suprabhata Seva at 5:00 AM and Maha Mangala Harathi at 12:00 PM performed with Vedic rituals.
service3_desc: Weekly satsangs and Ramayana parayanams fostering spiritual awakening and community harmony.
sponsor_desc: Support our ongoing Anna Daana program. Your donation nourishes pilgrims and devotees.
admin_login_desc: Enter Secret Admin PIN (Default: 108) to upload or manage floating media.
admin_file_label: Select Photo / Video File or Enter URL
footer_text: Preserving a century-old spiritual legacy in Inagaluru, Andhra Pradesh. Honoring devotion, literature, and selfless Anna Daana service.
